def fit_linear(x,y):
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x), x])
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
    pred = X@beta
    ss_res = np.sum((y-pred)**2)
    ss_tot = np.sum((y-y.mean())**2)
    r2 = 1-ss_res/ss_tot if ss_tot>0 else np.nan
    return beta,pred,r2

def loocv(x,y,intercept=True):
    n=len(y); errs=[]
    for i in range(n):
        mask = np.arange(n)!=i
        if intercept: beta,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack([np.ones(mask.sum()),x[mask]]),y[mask],rcond=None); p=beta[0]+beta[1]*x[i]
        else: beta=np.sum(x[mask]*y[mask])/np.sum(x[mask]**2); p=beta*x[i]
        errs.append(y[i]-p)
    return np.sqrt(np.mean(np.array(errs)**2))
